dedupe_keys.name: hai phong household waste sorting and willingness to pay survey 2025

description: This survey records household views and behaviour concerning domestic waste services in Hai Phong, Vietnam. Vietnam National University researchers and collaborators contacted 431 households in eight communes or wards during June–July 2025 through online and face-to-face methods. After excluding incomplete or implausible responses, repository methods report 414 observations. Variables cover satisfaction, waste separation, willingness to pay for service improvements and socioeconomic characteristics. Mendeley version 4 provides data and codebook workbooks plus a questionnaire, free under CC BY 4.0. City coverage is cross-sectional and sampled, not a household census. Hypothetical payments, mixed collection modes and the difference between surveyed and retained counts are limitations for estimating realised demand. Modellers could parameterise household participation and financing assumptions in waste-service simulations. model-odym is related to material-flow accounting and would require a separately developed behavioural component. No household responses were downloaded, and no contingent-valuation estimate was recalculated.
name: Hai Phong household waste-sorting and willingness-to-pay survey, 2025
